## Andrew
**Identity/work:** Andrew lives in the city and became a Financial Analyst in the week of March 20, 2023. He has a girlfriend.

**Family, pets & relationships:** He had a family dog and missed hiking with it. He had no personal pet on March 27, 2023, but later adopted Toby (a male German Shepherd), Buddy (from a shelter, October 2023), and Scout (adopted by November 22, 2023). Toby is active, loyal, likes sweaters, and once chased a squirrel. Andrew and his girlfriend enjoy cafés, restaurants, picnics, board games, wine tasting, biking, fishing, volunteering, and outings with the dogs.

**Hobbies and values:** Hiking is his favorite outdoor activity; he enjoys trails, greenery, mountain views, fresh air, photography, birdwatching, rock climbing, cooking, kayaking, and possibly bungee jumping. Nature restores him, calms stress, and helps him feel connected; he wants to share peaceful moments with others. He watches birds, especially eagles, has read about ecosystems, and believes nature should be protected for future generations. He recycles-mindedly discussed biking and public transport. Cooking helps him relax and be creative. He supports positive-reinforcement training and animal shelters.

**Goals/plans:** He sought dog-friendly housing near parks or woods so he could hike with a dog, eventually making city dog ownership work. He wants stronger bonds with his dogs, grooming knowledge, and outdoor trips with them.

**Timeline:**  
- **Mar 27, 2023:** Started Financial Analyst job; no pet; discussed birds and Fox Hollow.  
- **Apr–Jun 2023:** Searched for housing and a dog; hiked, cooked, and took a rock-climbing class.  
- **Jul 11:** Brought home Toby.  
- **Jul 24:** Volunteered at a pet shelter.  
- **Aug–Oct:** Camped, hiked, fished, biked, and spent time with Toby; work limited outdoor time.  
- **By Oct 19:** Adopted Buddy.  
- **Nov 4:** Had Toby and Buddy and was unsure about another dog.  
- **By Nov 22:** Adopted Scout and prepared a bed, toys, and puppy pads.

## Audrey
**Identity, family & pets:** Audrey’s dogs are her “little family” and mean everything to her. Her four dogs are Pepper, Pixie, Precious, and Panda. They have been described as two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes; later, Pepper and Panda were called Labrador mixes and Precious and Pixie Chihuahua mixes. She also remembers childhood dog Max fondly. She has a girlfriend/boyfriend not stated; no partner is mentioned.

**Activities and possessions:** Audrey walks her dogs multiple times daily, hikes, takes road trips, visits parks, beaches, and dog parks, arranges playdates, plays fetch and frisbee, and uses puzzles, training, and hide-and-seek for stimulation. She has practiced agility twice weekly, dog grooming, obedience, positive-reinforcement training, and animal-behavior routines. She cooks, makes jewelry from recycled materials, gardens (Peruvian lilies and vegetables), birdwatching interests her, and she enjoys nature, lakes, swimming, music, wine, and sushi. She has dog tattoos, personalized wooden tags, leashes, shoes, beds, toys, and a backyard agility area. She sells recycled jewelry and donates part of the profits to an animal shelter.

**Values:** Nature and dogs bring her peace, joy, and restoration. She prioritizes safety, patience, praise, exercise, socialization, gentle grooming, and reward-based training; she rejects punishment. She wants each dog healthy, happy, loved, and individually understood.

**Timeline:**  
- **Mar–Apr 2023:** Had Pepper, Precious, Panda; adopted Pixie.  
- **May–Jul:** Took road trips, trained the dogs, moved to a larger home, and began agility.  
- **Aug:** Added a four-dog tattoo, learned grooming, and took the dogs to the vet.  
- **Sep–Oct:** Managed a broken leash, injury, garden, beach trip, and behaviorist visit.  
- **Nov 4:** Joined a dog-owners group and continued weekly social meetups.  
- **Nov 17:** Took all four dogs to a grooming salon.
